title: Ultra Low-Power, Lightweight, Probabilistic RSS-Based Path Reconstruction: A System for Landscape-Scale Bee Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2608.27152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applications in fields such as movement ecology, Internet of Things or robotics share the need for systems that localize devices that are too small and power constrained to implement GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems). Alternative low-power localization methods often rely on only measurements of RSS (Received Signal Strength) to infer the AoA (Angle of Arrival) of a transmitted radio frequency signal, but are limited by range and the power demand of the large number of RSS measurements required to infer an accurate AoA. In this paper we address these issues with a novel RSS-based method for tracking ultra lightweight and low-power moving receivers across a complex landscape, achieved by using a minimal number of RSS measurements from simple rotating high-gain transmitters with a range of 300m, and applying probabilistic modelling to infer their AoA. translated_title: 超低功耗、轻量级、基于概率RSS的路径重建：一种用于景观尺度蜜蜂追踪的系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27152v1 公告类型：新 摘要：运动生态学、物联网或机器人技术等领域的应用共同需要能够定位那些体积过小且功耗受限而无法实现GNSS（全球导航卫星系统）的设备。替代性的低功耗定位方法通常仅依赖RSS（接收信号强度）测量来推断发射射频信号的AoA（到达角），但受限于范围和推断准确AoA所需的大量RSS测量的功耗需求。在本文中，我们通过一种新颖的基于RSS的方法解决了这些问题，该方法用于在复杂景观中追踪超轻量级和低功耗的移动接收器，通过使用少量来自简单旋转高增益发射器的RSS测量（范围达300米），并应用概率建模来推断其AoA。接收器的移动路径随后使用高斯过程建模并重建。
tldr: 本文提出一种仅用少量RSS测量和概率建模推断到达角的新方法，实现了对超轻量低功耗设备在复杂景观中的高效追踪，适用于蜜蜂等小型生物定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel RSS-based method that uses minimal measurements and probabilistic modeling to infer angle of arrival, enabling efficient tracking of ultra-lightweight, low-power devices in complex landscapes, suitable for bee localization.
